computeHistory.holdTitle: A reservation is not the final cost
computeHistory.holdBody: A task reserves its budget first, then settles verified usage and returns the remainder. An interruption or timeout does not prove that no cost occurred. Unresolved tasks retain their reservation; avoid starting the same task again.
computeHistory.deliveryBody: These statements confirm usage and charges, not whether a file was saved or is ready to collect. Check your results in AIGC Workspace. If a result is missing, inspect the original task before generating again.

stateBody.AUTHORIZED: The budget is reserved; supplier execution has not been confirmed to start.
stateBody.RUNNING: The task was authorized to start. Final usage has not been settled yet.
stateBody.UNCERTAIN: The result or usage has not been verified. The reservation remains held; do not restart the same task.
stateBody.SETTLED: Verified usage has been settled and the unused reservation has been returned.
stateBody.RELEASED: This budget was confirmed unused and its reservation was returned in full.

computeHistory.emptyBody: Workspace tasks appear here after you confirm their compute budget. Usage from other projects is not included in these totals.

difference.question: Membership or points vouchers?
difference.answer: Points vouchers fund compute when needed. Membership includes production tools and a stated points allowance. Learning, career work and AIGC share one membership. Plans are in preparation; purchase and membership redemption are not available.

payment.question: Can I buy VibePlan now?
payment.answer: Not yet. Plans are in preparation, with no payment, automatic renewal or presale. See the points center for vouchers that are actually available.

announcements.question: What will be confirmed before launch?
announcements.answer: Plan pricing, periodic points, quota expiry and rollover, specific benefits, plus purchase, renewal and cancellation terms will be explained before availability.

ratio.question: Why does the ¥49 plan include 300 points, not 490?
ratio.answer: The top-up rate is fixed at ¥1 for 10 points. The ¥49 VibePlan monthly term includes 300 points and membership tools. Its full price is not converted to points, and it does not change the top-up rate. Points are not a promise of cash redemption.

expiry.question: When do points expire?
expiry.answer: Under the confirmed terms, top-up points do not expire. Weekly plan points last 14 days; each monthly or quarterly batch lasts 60 days. Quarterly grants arrive in three batches. Membership expiry does not remove points before their own expiry. These plan rules require batch management; existing top-up balances stay unchanged.

renewal.question: Will I be charged automatically?
renewal.answer: The first release uses LDXP term vouchers with manual renewal and no automatic charges. Same-tier renewal extends the term with scheduled grants. Upgrades show a price difference first; downgrades take effect next term. Exact upgrade calculations and refund handling must be ready before sale.

ownership.question: What happens to my work when membership ends?
ownership.answer: Ownership, basic privacy and export of existing work do not depend on membership. Saved text, source code and manual versions are not suddenly deleted at expiry. Large-media retention, archiving and traffic terms still need to be specified; permanent free hosting is not promised. Commercial use remains subject to asset and third-party licenses.

failure.question: How are failed tasks charged?
failure.answer: The intended rules require a budget before execution. Unsubmitted or duplicate requests are not charged twice; the platform covers duplicate consumption caused by its own faults. Failures already charged upstream are settled from actual receipts. An unsatisfactory result does not automatically make a rerun free. Consult the terms and cost shown before each task.

market.question: Can plan points buy market goods or be withdrawn?
market.answer: No. Plan and promotional points are limited to permitted personal compute, with no transfers, withdrawals or purchases of withdrawable goods. Seller income uses a separate CNY ledger. Market commission, escrow and settlement need their own implementation and are not sold as current plan benefits.

workflowDetail.metadataDescription: Review the published version, prepare inputs and run this workflow on ANS.
workflowDetail.author: Maintained by {name} · Reviewed by an administrator
workflowDetail.resumeOutputBody: Turn your real experience into a personal page. Preview and download an HTML file after completion. Publishing the website requires separate hosting.
workflowDetail.genericOutputBody: The result comes from the final executed step in this version. Review the result and the execution record after completion.
workflowDetail.resumeFactsBody: Name, headline and introduction are required. Add education, skills and contact details as needed.
workflowDetail.resumeProjectsBody: Each project needs a name and description. Explain your contribution and optionally add your role and a result link.
workflowDetail.resumePreferencesBody: Choose a layout, accent color and Chinese or English output. These choices become part of your result.
workflowDetail.noVariables: This version declares no input fields. Confirm the model and cost in the run area below before starting.
workflowDetail.resumeChoices: Confirm your facts, style, language and cost before running. Check the generated copy and facts before applying or publishing.
workflowDetail.genericChoices: Confirm inputs, model and cost before running, then review the result. Condition steps are evaluated automatically.
workflowDetail.processExplanation: Steps follow the actual execution order and show their upstream inputs. Consecutive numbers do not necessarily mean connected steps.
workflowDetail.receivesInput: No upstream dependency; can use this run's inputs

nodeDescriptions.prompt: Fill the published prompt with inputs and upstream results.
nodeDescriptions.template: Apply a fixed template to inputs and existing results.
nodeDescriptions.model: Process this step with a model. Calls are charged under the current billing rules.
nodeDescriptions.condition: Compare upstream results using the published condition and produce a decision value.
nodeDescriptions.output: Prepare upstream results for output. The published version determines the delivery format.

workflowDetail.loginTitle: Sign in to start your own run
workflowDetail.loginBody: Inputs and results are saved to your run history. Return here after signing in, fill in your details and confirm the cost to start.
workflowDetail.executionLimit: A run can execute for up to 120 seconds. Each step has its own timeout and retry limits.
workflowDetail.versionNotice: Generic workflows use the latest published version when you click run, then keep that version for the task. Recipes and marketplace workflows verify the confirmed version. Refresh if this page has been open for a while.
workflowDetail.privacyNotice: Inputs are saved with the run record. Avoid sensitive information such as identity numbers or home addresses.
workflowDetail.reviewNotice: Review AI output, especially personal experience, data and references.
workflowDetail.unavailableTitle: This published version cannot run right now
workflowDetail.unavailableBody: The current definition could not be read or failed structural validation. Running is paused until the maintainer fixes it.
workflowDetail.rawDefinition: View input variables and the raw published definition

marketDetail.coverNote: Publisher-provided cover. The deliverables and selected tier define the delivery scope.
marketDetail.previewNote: Open the demo or source here when the publisher has provided one.
marketDetail.tiersNote: Compare what each tier includes. Your selection at checkout determines the order scope.
marketDetail.runCostBoundary: This listing binds an executable workflow. Compute costs require confirmation before a run; opening this page does not start a task.
marketDetail.freeCostBoundary: This listing is shared for free. External accounts, hosting, models and premium services follow the original provider's terms. A free listing does not make every external service free.
marketDetail.deliveryNote: Discuss requirements, delivery and revisions in the order. Requests beyond the published scope require a new agreement.
marketDetail.orderProcessNote: Choose a tier and create an order, pay and submit requirements, then review the publisher's delivery. Request revisions or report a dispute in the order as its status allows. Settlement follows delivery acceptance.

marketDetail.workflowVersionNote: Runs bind workflow version {version}, which is checked again before execution.
marketDetail.purchaseHeading: Confirm a tier and create an order
marketDetail.runPreparation: Enter your actual information, review the cost and explicitly confirm before starting. Results stay in your run history.
marketDetail.purchasePreparation: Check the deliverables and license first. After creating an order, complete payment and discuss requirements there.
marketDetail.runPriceNote: Confirm the compute cost before running.
marketDetail.freePriceNote: Free to view or obtain. External service terms are set by the original provider.
marketDetail.pointsPriceNote: This is a marketplace points quote. Any cash price appears separately in its payment option.
marketDetail.chooseAndBuy: Choose a tier and view checkout

marketStudio.title: 3D personal website
marketStudio.summary: Turn your experience, projects and personality into a website people can explore. See the result, arrange your model, stickers and camera stops, then take your work with you.
marketStudio.costNote: AI model generation and copy assistance require separate compute confirmation.
marketStudio.copyUnavailableNote: Copy assistance is temporarily unavailable. You can still edit, preview and export your website.
marketStudio.deliverableWebsite: A downloadable HTML website with your model, camera stops, stickers and personal content.
marketStudio.deliverableDraft: An editable JSON draft you can import again without regenerating your model.
marketStudio.deliverableAccount: Sign in to save and restore private versions. Uploaded local GLB models are included in local drafts but cannot yet be saved to your account.
marketStudio.howTitle: From experience to a finished website
marketStudio.prepareBody: Write your name, introduction and project experience. Use the demo model, upload your own GLB, or confirm the cost to generate an avatar.
marketStudio.composeBody: Arrange stickers, camera stops and content cards. Copy assistance lives under Animation → Home → Content. Confirm a run, then explicitly apply its output.
marketStudio.deliverTitle: Review, save, take it with you
marketStudio.deliverBody: Review the delivery panel and export HTML plus an editable draft. Sign in to save versions. Publish explicitly when sharing is available.
marketStudio.inputNote: Your name, introduction, at least one project and contact details you want to share. Use only images and models you have permission to use. Copy assistance supports up to 6 projects; additional content remains manually editable.
marketStudio.costBoundary: Editing, preview and file export do not call a model. Avatar generation and copy assistance each require cost confirmation and keep separate task records. Opening this page starts no task. Copy runs return reusable text and standard HTML; the 3D website is exported separately by the editor.
marketStudio.privacyNote: Inputs are saved with their private version or task. AI tasks send the required material to the selected model service. Avoid identity numbers, home addresses and other sensitive data. Saving does not publish your work; check contact details and asset permissions before sharing.
marketStudio.versionNote: This contract binds published listing version {version}. Website editing versions are saved separately; edits do not replace historical runs.
